notes: Shopify storefront (nicobar.com), robots.txt allows general crawling, no Claude-specific disallow - used direct HTTP fetch (collections.json across 5 pages covering 1247 collections total, homepage HTML nav/footer dump, search/suggest.json, and direct URL probes) throughout; Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome not needed. No Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End-of-Line PLP is exposed anywhere in the site's live customer-facing navigation: full-text grep of the homepage HTML (main nav, mega-menus, and footer) for 'sale'/'clearance'/'outlet' found zero nav/footer links; /collections/sale and /collections/clearance both resolve to 404 or redirect to the homepage (verified with curl -I -L), and /pages/sale is a 404. The only 'sale'-flavoured collections that exist in the raw collections.json catalog are backend/unlinked: (1) /collections/decor-on-sale ('Decor on sale', 7 products, H1 = 'Decor on sale', no permanence/clearance wording anywhere on the page, not linked from any nav/footer element) - a generic temporary-discount page, not a site-defined Clearance concept, so excluded per the Clearance-vs-Sale rule rather than flagged ambiguous (there is no ambiguity - it reads purely as a generic sale with zero clearance/outlet/permanence signal); (2) four EOSS ('End of Season Sale') Home variants - eoss-home-20/30/50/flat - which are also unlinked anywhere in nav and which, on direct products.json enumeration, are essentially empty (0, 1, 0, 0 products respectively) - dropped both as zero/near-zero listings and as unlinked seasonal-campaign artifacts, not clearance/outlet merchandising. Also checked 'after-sale-sequencing', 'all-products-sale', 'deeper-discounts', 'employee-discount'/'employee_discount_free_ship' in the same catalog scan - these read as internal/ops or staff-discount segmentation collections (not customer-facing merchandising pages) and are likewise unlinked from any nav/footer/sitemap-reachable path. Conclusion: Nicobar currently exposes no genuine Clearance-type merchandising PLP for Home (or any category) - this is an absence, not a miss.
